title: Astragalus membranaceus tincture for medicinal use
intro: Astragalus membranaceus tincture is a concentrated herbal preparation made from the root of the Astragalus plant, which is native to Asia. It is commonly used in traditional Chinese medicine and herbalism to support immune function and promote vitality. The tincture is typically taken orally, often in small doses, to help strengthen the body's defenses and enhance energy levels. It is believed to have adaptogenic properties, helping the body manage stress and maintain balance. This preparation is particularly valued for its potential role in respiratory and digestive health.
